translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Jiszs Maszlrpx-ngrde Drka' Kx Xplr Mz Kzdq Ncblo
Jiszs badr ncblo nedeng nzkaputrpzng mz nrlar Dxbu Gzlili mz nrlarnrlc kc tqycngr taon kcng nzpnu-esz', mrkc tzmncngr leplz kcng trngiulrJiu. X kzdq taon lcdeng dekc tqngi Gergesa.
Mzli kcpwz Jiszs tqpoo-ngrmle mz bot, vzm bade kc ncblo kx mncpx-ngrm drka'.

Dekc tqmncpx-ngrmle mz butqbr kx nzryrtzmqpx-ngrm namz ngr leplz. Apule ncblo kxayo, xplr-esz'ngrtx x rblx nzamnc-moungr nide x nzatolvangr. Nzwrde kqlupe kx nzpe-ngrbz mqde x nanycde mz nqvi x sen, a' zvz tqnikitileng x sa tqvz.
Zvz, ngrlx x nrlckxbq, nzvzne-krde mz butqbr x mz nra, tqkabo x tqtakrti-lzbq mz rplz.
Kx mcpxmle kc Jiszs rlru, sc tqngrlrpebz, rweobz zpr bade mz nzangio-krdele.
Rpibz Jiszs mz drka' kc kx, “Drka', prszpx mrlx la!” Sc tqnepe, tqrpipele kx, “Vrr! Jiszs, Mrlx Gct kc tqmyalz-esz'ngr! ?Nike tqotime? Esalzngr mz drtq Gct kx bzkq ayrplapxq nrkrdrtqnge!”
Jiszs veabz kx, “?Drtqm neke?” Rpibzle kx, “Drtqnge Siu Kqlu, murde kqlu-zlwzkr.”
X sc tqyrnititr-zvzbzle mz Jiszs kx bzkq atwzlr-ngrde nidr mz nrlarnrlc kzble.
X mnc-aepztrpz mrkc kzdq nrtrq r poi kxetu sc tzmung mz nra.
X drka' kcng nzyrnititr-mopwzlr mz Jiszs kx, “Atwzlr-ngrbz nigr mz nrtrq r poi kc, murde namncpx-alzupgr badr.”

Zbz sc tqrlrpe-ngrbz Jiszs nzvz-krdr. Drka' kcng nzprsrpxlr mrlx kc x nzdwatr-alzung mz poi kcng. X nrtrq r poi kc, poi ngrde siu-li (2,000), tzngrlropeng mz nqngitrlqli, nztaong mz nabz dxbu kc, x nzboong amrlx.
Zbz ncblo kcng tzaclveng, nzngrlrng sc tzpinepelr nrpa ngrde mz mztea x nabz nrlanc kcng. X leplz kxnzkqlung sc tzyrkrpebzng mz nzmc-krdr da kc tqprtz.
Nzvzmqng mz Jiszs x nzmcpelr ncblo kc tzprszpx drka' siu kqlu, wxbu-lrpipe, drtwrde opxpe, x pxipe. Kx nzmc leplz kxnzkqlule, sc tzmwxlrpe-ngrdr zmatq ngr Jiszs.
Leplz kcng nzrmc-kaing da amrlx kcng tqprtz nzpinebzlr mz kzdung kz leplz be ngr Jiszs ncdr ncblo kc, x drka' x poi kcng.
Zbz leplz kcng nzyrnitrpzlr mz Jiszs kx navzpe.
Mzli kc Jiszs naprtzpe-ngrde mz bot, ncblo kc tqamrlzle vzm bade sc tqyrnititrpebzle mz Jiszs kx navzng badr.
A' tr-rlrtx-ngrpwzu Jiszs. Rpi-alzupwzle bade kx, “Yzlubz mz lr mrnyzm x pibz badr da kxmrlz kc tqalebz Gct bam mz nzokatr-krde nim.”
Zbz mrlx kc rkalzm x sc tqayotipele nrlarnrlc kc mz taon kcng nzpnu-esz'. Tqyapwxtinepele da kxmrlz kcng tqalebz Jiszs bade. X leplz amrlx kcng tzxlrbzlr nzyapwx-krde nzkctitxpxlr zmatq ngr Jiszs.
Inyx Kzdq Kxetu R Mangr-nzkrka'ngr X Olvz Kc Tqmaletrpzle Lrpz Sc Jiszs
Jiszs badr ncblo nedeng nzalilvckio-moulr nrlar dxbu kc x zbo ngr leplz sc tzyrlwr-ngalelvzpe-moulr nide mz nabz drta'.

Zbz kzdq ncblo drtqde Jaerzs sc tqkaputrpem. Nide kzdq kxetu r mangr-nzkrka'ngr. Rtctxo-lzbq-ngrbz mz nanyc Jiszs x sc tqyrnititrpebzle kx, “Inyxnge yagox x sc nabzpe. Vzm bagr x maletrpz nrkrdrtqde x sa namnc zpwx mou.”
Zbz Jiszs sc tzvzpeng ncdr. Nzmncpxmqng mz mzlir leplz kxkqlu, kxnzrdrlvzti-lzbqng mz nzvz-krdr.
Zbz kzdq olvz kx tresakiu nzrpwx-krde temz prtr-kzpz mz zbo ngr leplz kcng. Nzrpwx-alo-krde lc temz, twztipelele yiz nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12).
Nzabzpebz dckta kxnzkqlung nzamrlz-krbzlr nzetqkr drtqde, x trau scdeng yrkrtipe mz nzxpeti-krde nidr x lue kxpiz kxkqlu. Tzrpilr nzamrlzngr drtqde, a' trpnzngr. X sc tqetunepx zlwz.

Olvz lc xlrle nrpa ngr nzamrlzkr Jiszs kxnzyagoxng. Sc tqrpipe drtwrde kx, “Nzmu namaletxtrpo ye lrpzde, drtqnge kc tqmrlzpe.” Sc tqrbinginetrpebz mz zbo ngr leplz kcng mz nibr Jiszs, x sc tqmaletrpebzle lrpzde.
X mzli kcpwz mepyr ngr drtqde sc tqmingrtrpe x tqxngipebzle kx drtqde mrlzpe.
X sc tqxngipe-kzpz Jiszs kx zmatq vzpxpem kcng mz drtqde x amrlzpele kzdq leplz. Lxlvrkimle mq x mzte kc tqvecpe mz nabz zbo ngr leplz kcng x sc tqveapebz kx, “?Neke tqmaletrple lrpznge?”
Ncblo nedeng nzayzlu-ngrbzlr natqde kx, “Rlr! ?Trmcwq zbo ngr leplz kang tqmncpx-ngrme? ?Memule tqveati-ngrn kx maletrpzle nim?”
A' Jiszs mzte sc tqvec zvz, murde namc-zpwxle leplz kc tqbxtrpzle lrpzde.
Olvz kc kx krlztrpele mz drtqde nzmrlzpe-krde, sc tqrnrcnepxpebz mz zmwxlr. Kxmule-esz' mwxlr a' atuobz zpr mz Jiszs mz nzangio-krdele, x sc tqpipebzle da angidr kc tqveatile.
Rpibz Jiszs kx, “Inyxnge. Nzlxngiti-krm ninge amrlzpele nim. Vzpe x bzkq da kx pnzpe drtwrm, nzmrlz-alo-krm lape.”
Mzli kc tqycmne-ngrbe Jiszs, kzdung ncblo kxnzatwzlr-ngrmqng mz ma nyz Jaerzs sc tzkaputrpemqng. Nzrpibzlr mz Jaerzs kx, “Kxetu, inyxm bzpe. Bzkq akxputipeq kxakrlz la.”
A' rpibz Jiszs bade kx, “Kxmule-esz', bzkq drtwrm talvzo, a' lxngiti ninge.”
X trpnzngr mou leplz kx rlr-ngrbzle nzvz-krdr badr, a' ngi txpwz Pita, Jemes, x mzlede Jon.
Kx nzkrlzbzlr kc ma nyz Jaerzs, sc tzxlrpelr nzyrni-katokr leplz kcng amrlx mrkc.
Nzdwatrpzng x sc tqrpipebzle kx, “Bzkq yrni-katopeamu. Doa lc trbzu, a' mwine ye!”
A' nzyrpalelvzlr nide. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, avztxpxleng yz amrlx ngrdr. X sc tzvztrpeng badr trte x lxe doa kc mrkc tqyrbqngr nide.
Zbz malebzle mqde, sc tqrpipebzle kx, “Tzlitz, koum!” drtwr ngrde “Doa olvz lc, tulzm!”
X mzli kcpwz doa olvz kc tulzm x sc tqvznepe. Kx nzmc lxede x trtede da lc nzkctitxpxlr. (Yiz ngr doa olvz lc nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li.)
A' rngidrtxtr-ngrbz Jiszs badr kx bzkq nzlenedr nrpa ngr da kc. X rpi-kzpzle kx, “Kabzmu du dakxnzng namu doa la.”

footnotes.text: Mz kzdung nzryrngr kcng pnz, taon lc nzrpibz Gadara o Gerasa.

Mwxlrti-lzbq zlwz mz nike na-alebz Jiszs badr zbo ngr leplz kcng bade. Murde nzyagox-krde batrpe-kzpzle trnztakitr-krdeu nide mz nzprtrngr mz nzangiongr, x batr-kzpzle doa kcng nabxtrpzlr nide, trnztakitr-kz-krdru mz nzprtrngr mz nzangiongr mz nzvz-nqblq-krde Lou sc Mosis. Mc Livae 15:19-30.
